heading: Users struggle with action item management and question AI note-taking accuracy.

blocks.alt: Fleet Ai — Users struggle with action item management and question AI note-taking accuracy.

blocks.html:
I interviewed 12 people from different industries who frequently take virtual and hybrid meetings.


And I constructed 20 interview questions about their journey and experience before, during, after, and between meetings.

The goal is to find common pain points that lower their work efficiency and make them feel tedious.
